ratingNote: Machine-verified 2026-09-05 using the Japan iTunes Lookup API (https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp): averageUserRating 4.24, userRatingCount 25. Visible ratings and JSON-LD use the same one-decimal value, 4.2. Run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write after changing ratingValue/ratingCount. The raw API average has more precision than the published value.
appVersionNote: PUBLIC App Store version. Owner-confirmed 2026-09-02 by reading the live App Store: v5.8.4 (rating 4.2 / 25 unchanged). The 2026-09-01 report had read 5.8.2; the owner's 09-02 check supersedes it. Keep this as the RELEASED version, not simplememo-ios/project.pbxproj's MARKETING_VERSION (5.8.5 on 2026-09-02, TestFlight): release.yml ships tag -> Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight and App Review submission is a separate opt-in step (submit_review defaults to false), so the two legitimately diverge. Re-check with: curl -s 'https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp' | grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' — then edit this one field and run: node scripts/sync_constants.js --write to propagate to the JSON-LD blocks and llms.txt. The daily seo-daily.yml job runs check-store-facts.mjs --net and reports drift automatically.

priceNote: Confirmed unchanged by the owner on 2026-08-22. Values were set 2026-06-11 (PR #342) and have not been changed since — the owner states the prices are still current. **Still not machine-verified against App Store Connect**: IAP prices are not returned by the iTunes Lookup API, and the ASC API needs credentials this sandbox does not have. Prices appear on the site (pricing sections and JSON-LD offers), so a stale value would be a consumer-protection risk, not just a docs bug: Apple periodically adjusts JPY price tiers for FX. If that ever happens, update these four fields and this note's date, then run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write. Checked by scripts/check-store-facts.mjs (180-day window; longer than ratings because prices rarely change, but not unbounded).
